title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction: This is the last page of the manuscript. It finishes a remark begun on p.90 about the 'structure à l'infini' of M_{g,ν}. That structure is the boundary stratification of the Deligne–Mumford–Knudsen compactification, a normal-crossings divisor in the stack sense, treated as a stratified (tame/modéré) space. Grothendieck has a simplicial system D_Δ indexed by flags (chains) of strata, i.e. essentially the nerve of the poset or exit-path category of strata. On p.90 he notes that the 'first vertex/source' map σ: D_{Δ_r} → D_{Δ_0} is finite étale over the open part D*_{Δ_0}. Fix a stratum S and a point x on it. The local strata near x that contain S in their closure form a finite ordered set, and this ordered set varies as a locally constant (finite étale) system over S. The sentence ending on this page says that this local poset is isomorphic to the set of parts (subsets) of a finite set, a Boolean lattice. This is special to normal crossings: at a point where n branches cross, the local strata correspond to subsets of the n branches. He then gives a counterexample: the tripod, three branches issuing from one point (or three half-planes along an edge). At the central stratum the local poset has the centre, 3 branches and 3 sectors, so 7 elements. Since 7 is not a power of 2, the poset is not Boolean. In the NB he records that the local-triviality hypothesis (p.86 e), i.e. Thom–Mather type local triviality along strata) has not yet been used. It will be used later to describe certain tubular neighbourhoods as locally trivial fibrations, running over the 'elementary types' classified in the previous section. The program is a combinatorial-topological description of the neighbourhood of infinity in M_{g,ν}: strata, links and tubular neighbourhoods encoded by finite étale data over strata. This belongs to the 'topologie modérée' / Teichmüller-tower circle of ideas of the Esquisse.
errors: No mathematical error. The claim that a Boolean local poset is special to normal crossings is correct, and the tripod counterexample with 7 = 1+3+3 local strata is consistent. Strictly, a Boolean local poset is necessary for normal crossings but not sufficient as a characterization of NC; Grothendieck does not claim it is.

ideas.what: Locally constant finite system of local strata containing a given stratum, encoded by finite étale 'source' maps D_{Δ_r}→D_{Δ_0} in a simplicial system indexed by flags of strata
ideas.modern_name: nerve of the exit-path category of a stratified space; constructible/exit-path data (MacPherson, Treumann, Lurie HA App. A)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 sketches tame topology/stratified structures, but not this simplicial formalism explicitly

ideas.what: For a normal-crossings stratification the local poset of strata at a point is the Boolean lattice of subsets of the branches; fails for the tripod (7 elements, not a power of 2)
ideas.modern_name: Boolean (cubical) local structure of SNC/NC stratifications; dual complex / cone complex of a NC divisor
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore (dual complexes: Deligne, Kontsevich–Soibelman, Abramovich–Caporaso–Payne tropical M_{g,n})

ideas.what: Local triviality along strata to be used to present tubular neighbourhoods as locally trivial fibrations over elementary types
ideas.modern_name: Thom–Mather control data / tubular neighbourhoods in stratified spaces
ideas.where_published: Esquisse §5 mentions tubular neighbourhoods in tame topology in general terms

missed.claim: Grothendieck planned to use local triviality to describe tubular neighbourhoods of the boundary strata of M_{g,ν} as locally trivial fibrations organized by the 'elementary types'. The manuscript stops here, so this part was never written.
missed.quote: Elle servira plus loin, pour expliciter en termes de fibrations loc. triviales certains voisinages tubulaires
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It corresponds to the later literature on the topology of the boundary of moduli spaces: Harer–Ivanov boundary structure, Kontsevich–Soibelman and ACP tropical links, and stratified homotopy types of M̄_{g,n}. The thread is mostly covered by later work and is only modestly novel.

deep.surprise_reason: These are routine but well-chosen observations on stratified spaces: Boolean local posets characterize the normal-crossings case, with a tripod counterexample. A planned but unwritten treatment of tubular neighbourhoods is noted. Historically interesting as an anticipation of exit-path/simplicial encodings of stratifications, but nothing a specialist would find new.
transcription_corrections: 'ens. fermé' should almost certainly read 'ens. fini' (the local poset is isomorphic to the set of parts of a finite set).
'Jac 7' likely reads 'card 7' or similar: the local poset at the tripod's centre has 7 elements.
'strates centraux' is plausibly 'strate centrale' (the central stratum of the tripod).
The interlinear insertion 'parcourant les ...' is uncertain; the sense is 'running over' the elementary types.
